file_name: Too Lost - Xelon Entertainment (MN-65045) - Third-party questionnaire - 12 November 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Too Lost and Xelon are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Too Lost and/or Xelon.
